skills.name: Start the Beat (音弦動)
skills.line: How did I feel when I first came to this world?
skills.description: Miku starts the beat to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. ;Tempo (リズム) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Each stack increases her damage reduction by 12%. Each stack also grants all allies True Rhythm, absorbs damage equal to 5% of her HP, lasts for 2 turns. ;True Rhythm (心の弦) : :'''Buff, Mark''': A shield that can absorb a certain amount of damage up to 35% of Miku's initial HP.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 120% and grants her 1 Tempo stack.

skills.name: Music On (音律起)
skills.line: I feel blessed to sing this heart-stirring song for you.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. If Miku isn't inflicted with any control effect when an ally other than herself uses a special skill, she'll Perform along. ; : ;Tempo (リズム) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Each stack increases her damage reduction by 12%. Each stack also grants all allies True Rhythm, absorbs damage equal to 5% of her HP, lasts for 2 turns. ;True Rhythm (心の弦) : :'''Buff, Mark''': A shield that can absorb a certain amount of damage up to 35% of Miku's initial HP.

skills.name: Perform (演奏)
skills.description: Miku increases the ally's damage by 6% and grants her 1 Tempo stack.

skills.name: Iconic Dance Song (音の舞曲)
skills.line: Thank you for loving every sparkling version of me.
skills.description: Miku can switch rhythms by choosing one of following skills; Iconic Dance Song: Overture, Iconic Dance Song: Chorus, Iconic Dance Song: Finale.

upgrades.text: '''Iconic Dance Song: Overture''': ATK increases to 39%.
'''Iconic Dance Song: Chorus''': Increases all allies SPD by 39, sustained for 1 turn.
'''Iconic Dance Song: Finale''': Onibi gained increases to 8.
Upon usage, spending Tempo stacks to activate this skill will be prioritised over onibi.

skills.name: Iconic Dance Song: Overture (音の舞曲・序幕)
skills.description: Miku increases all allies ATK by 25% of their initial ATK, sustained for 2 turns.

skills.name: Iconic Dance Song: Chorus (音の舞曲・中幕)
skills.description: Miku increases allies' move bars by 25%.
